concept.name: Attention mechanism
concept.definition: A differentiable operation that forms each output as a weighted combination of value vectors, with weights derived from compatibility between queries and keys.
concept.intuition: It is a learnable mapping or representation used to turn features into predictions or groups.
concept.mechanics: Compute query-key scores, scale and normalize them with softmax, then multiply the resulting weights by values; multiple heads learn different projections.
concept.failure_modes: Flexible models can fit noise, shift under new regimes, and conceal instability when tuning is repeated on the same validation data.
concept.misconceptions: Greater model complexity or in-sample accuracy does not by itself imply better out-of-sample trading results.
concept.example: A query for the current day assigns 60% of its weight to a recent volatility shock and smaller weights to other days.

citations.source: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need
